**Why the save-loop is untouched:**
- `mvn test` (the everyday command) still runs only the original 3 unit/integration tests, unchanged in time (~5-8s).
- `mvn verify` (build/CI) additionally runs the 7 architecture checks (~1.9s extra).

**Verified it actually catches violations:** I temporarily made `Money` (domain) depend on `org.springframework.util.Assert`, confirmed `mvn test` stayed green while `mvn verify` failed with a clear ArchUnit violation message, then reverted the temporary change.
